info.title: MCCY EU
info.description: OpenAPI definition for the Initiate Fx Payment endpoint.

parameters.name: Authorization
parameters.description: Your API token, obtained from the ClearBank Portal.

parameters.name: DigitalSignature
parameters.description: Signed hash of the body of the request. The hash is signed by your private key.

parameters.name: X-Request-Id
parameters.description: A unique identifier for the request; valid for 24 hours, max length 83.

requestBody.description: The Fx payment request based on PAIN.001.

200.description: The payment was initiated and a quote returned.

409.description: A payment with the same UETR already exists.

post.summary: Accept (execute) a previously quoted AutoFX payment.

parameters.name: Authorization
parameters.description: Your API token, obtained from the ClearBank Portal.

parameters.name: DigitalSignature
parameters.description: Signed hash of the body of the request. The hash is signed by your private key.

parameters.name: X-Request-Id
parameters.description: A unique identifier for the request; valid for 24 hours, max length 83.

requestBody.description: The AutoFX payment acceptance request identifying the quoted payment to execute.

202.description: The payment was accepted and queued for execution.

422.description: The request was invalid or the quote could not be found or has expired.

409.description: A conflicting execution for the payment already exists.

instructionIdentification.description: Unique identification, as assigned by an instructing party for an instructed party, to unambiguously identify the instruction.

endToEndIdentification.description: Unique identification, as assigned by the initiating party, to unambiguously identify the transaction.

uetr.description: Universally Unique Identifier (UUID) version 4, as described in IETF RFC 4122.

PaymentIdentification.description: Unique identification of the payment transaction.

department.description: Identification of a division of a large organisation or building.

subDepartment.description: Identification of a sub-division of a large organisation or building.

streetName.description: Name of a street or thoroughfare.

buildingNumber.description: Number that identifies the position of a building on a street.

buildingName.description: Name of the building or house.

floor.description: Floor or storey within a building.

postBox.description: Numbered box in a post office, assigned to a person or organisation, where letters are kept until called for.

postCode.description: Identifier consisting of a group of letters and/or numbers that is added to a postal address to assist the sorting of mail.

townName.description: Name of a built-up area, with defined boundaries, and a local government.

townLocationName.description: Specific location name within the town.

districtName.description: Identifies a subdivision within a country sub-division.

countrySubDivision.description: Identifies a subdivision of a country, such as state, region or county.

country.description: Country code following the ISO 3166-1 Alpha-2 standard.

PostalAddress.description: The postal address of a party.

anyBIC.description: Code allocated to a financial institution as described in ISO 9362.

lei.description: Code allocated to a party as described in ISO 17442.

OrganisationIdentification.description:
Unique and unambiguous way to identify an organisation.
Either AnyBIC or LEI must be provided, but not both.

birthDate.description: Date of birth, formatted as YYYY-MM-DD, in alignment with the ISO 8601 standard.

provinceOfBirth.description: Province where a person was born.

cityOfBirth.description: City where a person was born.

countryOfBirth.description: Country code following the ISO 3166-1 Alpha-2 standard.

PersonIdentification.description: Unique and unambiguous way to identify a person.

name.description: The legal name of this party.

countryOfResidence.description: Country code following the ISO 3166-1 Alpha-2 standard.

PartyIdentification.description:
Identifies a party.
Provide neither or either OrganisationIdentification or PrivateIdentification, but not both.

name.description: Name of the account, as assigned by the account servicing institution.

iban.description: A code used to uniquely identify the account of a customer at a financial institution as described in the 2007 edition of the ISO 13616 standard.

currency.description: The currency of this account, given as a three-letter ISO 4217 currency code.

DebtorAccount.description:
Unambiguous identification of the account of the debtor to which a debit entry will be made as a result of the transaction.
For outbound payments the DebtorAccount is a ClearBank account so an IBAN must always be provided.

clearingSystemIdentificationCode.description: Follows the latest version of the External Code Set, available at www.iso20022.org.

clearingSystemIdentificationProprietary.description: Proprietary identification of the clearing system.

memberIdentification.description: Identification of a member of a clearing system.

ClearingSystemMemberIdentification.description:
Unique identification, as assigned by a clearing system, to unambiguously identify a member of the clearing system.
Either ClearingSystemIdentificationCode or ClearingSystemIdentificationProprietary must be provided, but not both.

bicfi.description: Code allocated to a financial institution as described in ISO 9362.

name.description: Name by which the financial institution is known.

BranchAndFinancialInstitutionIdentificat.description:
Identifies a financial institution.
Either BICFI or ClearingSystemMemberIdentification must be provided, but not both.

instructionPriority.description: Indicator of the urgency or order of importance that the instructing party would like the instructed party to apply to the processing of the instruction.

serviceLevelCode.description: Agreement under which or rules under which the transaction should be processed. Follows the latest version of the External Code Set.

localInstrumentCode.description: User community specific instrument. Follows the latest version of the External Code Set.

categoryPurposeCode.description: Specifies the high level purpose of the instruction based on a set of pre-defined categories. Follows the latest version of the External Code Set.

PaymentTypeInformation.description: Set of elements used to further specify the type of transaction.

amount.description: Indicates the amount of a given currency to be used.

currency.description: The currency, given as a three-letter ISO 4217 currency code.

AmountType.description: A number of monetary units specified in an active or historic currency where the unit of currency is explicit and compliant with ISO 4217.

name.description: Name of the account, as assigned by the account servicing institution.

iban.description: A code used to uniquely identify the account of a customer at a financial institution as described in the 2007 edition of the ISO 13616 standard.

accountIdentification.description: Identification of the account, provided when no IBAN is available.

accountIdentificationCode.description: Follows the latest version of the External Code Set, available at www.iso20022.org.

currency.description: The currency of this account, given as a three-letter ISO 4217 currency code.

CreditorAccount.description:
Information about the creditor account in a given transaction.
Either IBAN or AccountIdentification must be provided, but not both.

code.description: Follows the latest version of the External Code Set, available at www.iso20022.org.

instructionInformation.description: Further information complementing the coded instruction or instruction to the creditor's agent that is bilaterally agreed or specific to a user community.

InstructionForCreditorAgent.description:
Further information related to the processing of the payment instruction, provided by the initiating party, and intended for the creditor agent.
Either Code or InstructionInformation must be provided, but not both.

code.description: Follows the latest version of the External Code Set, available at www.iso20022.org.

proprietary.description: Proprietary purpose, as defined by a party outside of an ISO code set.

Purpose.description:
Underlying reason for the payment transaction.
Either Code or Proprietary must be provided, but not both.

debitCreditReportingIndicator.description: Identifies whether the regulatory reporting information applies to the debit side, the credit side or both.

authorityName.description: Name of the entity requiring the regulatory reporting information.

authorityCountry.description: Country of the entity that requires the regulatory reporting information.

type.description: Specifies the nature, purpose, and reason for the transaction to be reported.

date.description: Date related to the specified type of regulatory reporting details.

country.description: Country code following the ISO 3166-1 Alpha-2 standard.

code.description: Specifies the nature, purpose, and reason for the transaction to be reported for regulatory and statutory requirements.

information.description: Additional details that cater for specific domestic regulatory requirements.

RegulatoryReporting.description: Information needed due to regulatory and/or statutory requirements.

code.description: Follows the latest version of the External Code Set, available at www.iso20022.org.

ReferredDocumentType.description:
Specifies the type of the document referred to in the remittance information.
Either Code or Proprietary must be provided, but not both.

number.description: Unique and unambiguous identification of the referred document.

relatedDate.description: Date associated with the referred document.

ReferredDocumentInformation.description: Set of elements used to identify the documents referred to in the remittance information.

creditDebitIndicator.description: Specifies whether the adjustment must be subtracted or added to the total amount.

additionalInformation.description: Provides further details on the document adjustment.

DocumentAdjustment.description: Set of elements used to provide information on the document adjustment.

discountAppliedAmount.description: Amount of money resulting from the application of an agreed discount to the amount due and payable to the creditor.

taxAmount.description: Quantity of cash resulting from the calculation of the tax.

adjustmentAmountAndReason.description: Set of elements used to provide information on the amount and reason of the document adjustment.

ReferredDocumentAmount.description: Set of elements used to provide information on the amounts of the referred document.

code.description: Follows the latest version of the External Code Set, available at www.iso20022.org.

issuer.description: Entity that assigns the creditor reference type.

CreditorReferenceType.description:
Specifies the type of creditor reference.
Either Code or Proprietary must be provided, but not both.

reference.description: Unique reference, as assigned by the creditor, to unambiguously refer to the payment transaction.

CreditorReferenceInformation.description: Reference information provided by the creditor to allow the identification of the underlying documents.

referredDocumentInformation.description: Provides the identification and the content of the referred document.

additionalRemittanceInformation.description: Additional information, in free text form, to complement the structured remittance information.

StructuredRemittanceInformation.description:
Information supplied to enable the matching/reconciliation of an entry with the items that the payment
is intended to settle, in a structured form.

unstructured.description:
Information supplied to enable the matching/reconciliation of an entry with the items that the payment
is intended to settle, in an unstructured form.

structured.description:
Information supplied to enable the matching/reconciliation of an entry with the items that the payment
is intended to settle, in a structured form.

RemittanceInformation.description: Information supplied to enable the matching/reconciliation of an entry with the items that the payment is intended to settle.

instructedAmount.description: Exactly one of InstructedAmount or EquivalentAmount must be provided. A number of monetary units specified in an active or historic currency where the unit of currency is explicit and compliant with ISO 4217.

equivalentAmount.description: Exactly one of InstructedAmount or EquivalentAmount must be provided. A number of monetary units specified in an active or historic currency where the unit of currency is explicit and compliant with ISO 4217.

chargeBearer.description: Specifies which party/parties will bear the charges associated with the processing of the payment transaction.

instructionForDebtorAgent.description: Further information related to the processing of the payment instruction, intended for the debtor agent.

regulatoryReporting.description: Information needed due to regulatory and/or statutory requirements.

relatedRemittanceIdentification.description: Unique identification, as assigned by the initiating party, to unambiguously identify related remittance information.

FxPaymentRequest.description: Individual Fx Payment Request based on PAIN.001.

uetr.description: The universally unique identifier you provided when requesting this payment transaction.

paymentId.description: The unique ClearBank identifier for the payment.

exchangeRate.description: The exchange rate of this payment for the requested currency pair (Origin:Target).

instructedCurrency.description: The currency this payment will use from your account, given as a three-letter ISO 4217 currency code.

instructedAmount.description: The amount of the origin currency that will be paid from your account for this transaction, including fees.

equivalentCurrency.description: The target currency that the recipient will receive, given as a three-letter ISO 4217 currency code.

equivalentAmount.description: The amount of the target currency that the creditor will receive after fees.

paymentValueDate.description: The date-time this payment request was valued at.

expiryDateTime.description: The date-time this open payment request will expire if it is not accepted first.

paymentId.description: The unique ClearBank identifier for the payment.
